title: Apple Aerial Wallpaper Videos
explanation: Downloaded aerial wallpaper and screensaver videos. macOS can recreate this folder if the feature is used again.
sideEffect: Wallpaper or screensaver choices may reset, and macOS may redownload videos later.

title: Apple Wallpaper Support Data
explanation: Apple wallpaper metadata, thumbnails, manifests, and downloaded wallpaper assets.
sideEffect: Wallpaper settings may reset. Prefer removing the aerial videos subfolder when it is listed separately.

title: Adobe Camera Raw Cache
explanation: Adobe Camera Raw stores preview and processing cache files here.
sideEffect: Adobe apps may rebuild previews and feel slower for the first few opens.

title: Lightroom Classic Cache
explanation: Lightroom Classic cache data used to speed up image browsing and editing.
sideEffect: Lightroom may regenerate previews and cached data.

title: Aftershoot Backend Cache
explanation: Aftershoot processing cache files. These are usually rebuildable support files, not source photos.
sideEffect: Aftershoot may rebuild local processing cache later.

title: Xcode Derived Data
explanation: Xcode build products, indexes, and intermediate files.
sideEffect: Xcode will rebuild project indexes and derived build output later.

title: Xcode iOS Device Support
explanation: Device symbols and support files Xcode stores after connecting iPhones or iPads.
sideEffect: Xcode may recreate support files when devices are connected again.

title: User Simulator Devices
explanation: Local iOS simulator devices, apps, and runtime data.
sideEffect: Removing device data can erase simulator-installed apps and local test data. Prefer managing simulators in Xcode.

title: npm Download Cache
explanation: npm package tarballs and metadata used to speed up installs.
sideEffect: Future npm installs may be slower while packages redownload.

title: npx Temporary Packages
explanation: Temporary packages downloaded by npx commands.
sideEffect: npx may redownload tools the next time they are used.

title: pnpm Cache
explanation: pnpm package cache used to speed up JavaScript installs.
sideEffect: pnpm may redownload packages later.

title: pip Cache
explanation: Python package download cache.
sideEffect: pip may redownload packages later.

title: uv Cache
explanation: uv package and environment cache for Python projects.
sideEffect: uv may redownload packages later.

title: Claude VM Bundles
explanation: Claude desktop runtime bundles and virtual machine assets.
sideEffect: Claude runtime bundles may contain active VM state. Use Claude-provided maintenance options instead.

title: Google Browser Profile Data
explanation: Chrome and Google app profiles, site storage, extensions, and account data.
sideEffect: Removing this can affect browser profiles, extensions, login state, and local web app data.

title: Google Cache
explanation: Cache used by Google apps and Chrome. This may include browser cache and local web app data.
sideEffect: Browser cache and local web app state may be recreated or reset.

title: Steam Library Content
explanation: Installed Steam games and downloaded game content.
sideEffect: Prefer uninstalling games through Steam. Removing this directly can break Steam installs.

title: Homebrew Download Cache
explanation: Downloaded bottles and sources cached by Homebrew.
sideEffect: Homebrew may need to redownload packages. Avoid cleanup during installations.

title: Hugging Face Model Cache
explanation: Downloaded AI models and datasets can consume large amounts of disk space.
sideEffect: Model files may need to be downloaded again. Local changes or offline workflows could be affected.

title: PyTorch Model Cache
explanation: Cached PyTorch model weights and repository downloads.
sideEffect: AI workflows may require redownloading models. Inspect before deleting.

title: Gradle Build Cache
explanation: Android and JVM dependencies and intermediate build caches.
sideEffect: Gradle may download packages and rebuild; check for offline projects.

title: Xcode Archives
explanation: Exportable signed app archives and historical app builds.
sideEffect: May contain unique signed release artifacts; remove only through Xcode Organizer.

title: Docker Desktop Container State
explanation: Images, volumes, and container runtime data. Some volumes contain persistent databases.
sideEffect: Do not delete directly. Use Docker Desktop or docker commands to inspect and prune safely.

title: OrbStack Machine State
explanation: Local virtual machines, container images, and persistent runtime state.
sideEffect: Do not delete directly. Manage machines and images inside OrbStack.

title: Codex Local State
explanation: Local Codex configuration and agent runtime state.
sideEffect: Can include valuable sessions and credentials. Inspection only.
